name: Panao Antpitta
rangeDescription: East slope of the andes of central peru (huánuco south of the río huallaga and pasco north of the río perené)
description: One of several new antpittas that were previously considered to be forms of what was then called Rufous Antpitta. Panao Antpitta is restricted to a small area of the eastern Andes in central Peru east of the city of Huánuco.

name: White-throated Robin-Chat
rangeDescription: Eastern botswana to southern mozambique, eswatini, and northeastern south africa
description: A striking medium-sized robin-chat with a slaty gray crown and back separated from the black wings and face mask by a white bar in the shoulder and a white eyebrow, respectively. The throat and breast are white, fading into amber orange on the vent, on the rump, and in the outer tail.

name: Sulphur-bearded Reedhaunter
rangeDescription: Southern brazil (rio grande do sul) to uruguay and eastern argentina
description: Distinctive spinetail with a yellow chin and dark brown patches on otherwise cinnamon wings. Has a well-marked white eyebrow and white underparts streaked gray.

name: Meek's Lorikeet
rangeDescription: Bougainville, kolombangara, new georgia, santa isabel, guadalcanal, and malaita (northern and central solomon islands)
description: An entirely green lorikeet, often seen in flight, with a long, pointed yellow-tipped tail and a small bluish crown patch. Bill and feet orange.

name: Demoiselle Crane
rangeDescription: Palearctic; winters in northeastern africa and southern asia
description: Small gray crane of open expansive habitats. Adult is an elegantly smooth shade of gray with a black neck, fiery eyes, and pure white plumes extending out from behind the eyes.

name: Ross's Goose
rangeDescription: Breeds tundra of arctic north-central canada; winters to western and central usa and central mexico
description: Cute miniature version of Snow Goose with smaller body, shorter neck, and stubbier bill. Pay special attention to the bill: short, with a straighter border where it meets the face, a much less obvious dark “grin patch,” and often bluish-gray color at the base.

name: Bearded Barbet
rangeDescription: Western sahel (northern senegambia to northwestern central african republic)
description: Large, colorful barbet with a huge ivory-colored bill. Note the red underparts with a thick black bar across the middle.

name: White-collared Oliveback
rangeDescription: Mountains of eastern democratic republic of the congo, western uganda, northern rwanda, burundi, and northwestern tanzania
description: Tiny olive-green, gray, and black member of the waxbill family. Males have a narrow white collar and an olive-green breast, while females lack the collar and have all-gray underparts.

name: Red-tailed Shrike
rangeDescription: Iran to pakistan, southern kazakhstan, and far western china (western xinjiang)
description: Small, plain shrike of dry, open areas with low shrubby cover. Gray-backed and white-bellied, with a black mask and a rusty tail and crown.

name: Black-cheeked Lovebird
rangeDescription: Southern zambia and far northern zimbabwe
description: A gregarious small green parrot with a red bill, white eye-ring and chocolate-brown face. Immature has a duller bill and eye-ring.

name: Buff-throated Monal-Partridge
rangeDescription: Mountains of eastern tibet and southwestern china
description: Large terrestrial bird of alpine shrublands and meadows. Matte brown overall, with red skin around the eye, white barring on the back, rusty throat, and rusty flank striping.

name: Daurian Jackdaw
rangeDescription: Southern siberia to mongolia, northern china, and southeastern tibet; winters to southern china
description: Small stout crow; often seen in large flocks, sometimes with other crows. Adult’s white neck and belly are unique in the region.

name: Papuan Thornbill
rangeDescription: New guinea (snow mountains to owen stanley range)
description: A small bird of upper montane and subalpine forest canopy and bushes. Dull brown upperparts, whitish underparts and yellowish tinged head, neck and upper chest.

name: Red-billed Curassow
rangeDescription: Lowland forest of southeastern brazil; on verge of extinction
description: Very large terrestrial species. Males are mostly black with a curly crest and a white belly and vent.

name: Yellow-rumped Marshbird
rangeDescription: Eastern paraguay to southern brazil, uruguay, and northern argentina
description: Large blackbird with a long, thin bill found in marshes and wetlands. Mostly dark brown with a yellow belly, rump, and shoulders.

name: Santa Marta Brushfinch
rangeDescription: Santa marta mountains (northeastern colombia)
description: A very distinctive brushfinch endemic to the Santa Marta Mountains of Colombia. It has a simple yet very attractive plumage pattern with a black head, white ear, yellow underparts, and gray back.

name: Anjouan White-eye
rangeDescription: Anjouan island (comoros)
description: A small, sharp-billed warbler-like bird. Note the yellow patches on the throat and undertail and the bold white spectacles around the eye.

name: Apical Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Arid scrub of colombia (west of the eastern andes)
description: Medium-sized, dull flycatcher without many distinguishing features; typical of the genus Myiarchus. This species is restricted to Colombia, where it is found in dry woodland and scrubby habitat below 1700m.

name: Santa Marta Sabrewing
rangeDescription: Santa marta mountains (northeastern colombia)
description: Rare hummingbird endemic to Colombia’s Santa Marta Mountains. Male is green with a blue throat, and female is green above and mostly white below.

name: Ecuadorian Thrush
rangeDescription: Coastal western ecuador (esmeraldas) to far northwestern peru (tumbes)
description: A common thrush of clearings and forest edge in most of western Ecuador; also reaches far northwestern Peru. Adult’s tan plumage, yellow bill, and orange eyering are distinct in its range.
